# Methods

_Scientific Data Data Descriptor · Section 2 · Target 1500–3000 words._

## 2.1 Scope and definitions

**Curtailment** is electricity that could have been generated by a committed renewable asset but was not, because of a system-operator instruction, a market rule, or a transmission constraint. Four phenomena are stored as one class: dispatch-down, constrained-off, hydro spill, and geothermal steam venting. Full operational notes: `src/methodology.md`.

Associated-gas flaring is out of scope. It was removed on 18 June 2026.

**Regions.** Smallest unit the operator publishes: US ISO or BA; ENTSO-E bidding zone; Brazilian sub-state cluster; Japanese TSO area; national grid otherwise. Stable kebab-case ids in `src/lib/regions.ts`. **459 regions, 191 countries and territories.**

**Time.** Hourly UTC. 15- and 30-minute feeds are averaged to the hour. `profile[24]` is the 30-day trailing GW average; `latestProfile[24]` is the last complete UTC day where the feed supports it.

## 2.2 Upstream sources

| Source | What it covers | Protocol |
|---|---|---|
| ENTSO-E Transparency | European bidding zones (generation × rate; see rate audit) | REST, XML, token |
| Netztransparenz | Germany’s four TSO areas, measured renewable redispatch | OAuth2 |
| EIA-930 | US ISOs and second-tier BAs | REST, JSON, key |
| AEMO NEMWeb | Five NEM states + named plants | Daily ZIP/CSV |
| Elexon BMRS | Great Britain, split Scotland / England+Wales | REST |
| ONS Brazil | State clusters, frustrated generation (GNRa) | CSV |
| Japan `eria_jukyu` area CSVs | Ten TSO areas, direct 太陽光/風力出力制御量 | HTTPS CSV |
| XM Colombia | Hydro spill (vertimientos), via Colombian egress | CSV relay |
| EirGrid, Energinet, Elia, RTE, CEN Chile, EMI NZ, Eskom, others | National / TSO feeds | REST or CSV |

Every loader is `src/data/<source>.json.ts`, wrapped in `withFallback` so a dead upstream serves the committed last-good snapshot and stamps `sourceStatus` `cached` or `degraded`. T3-modelled records are never stamped `live`.

ENTSO-E has no curtailed-renewable product. A77 is plant outages. Measured EU curtailment is national. Several ENTSO-E rates remain placeholders (`docs/methodology/entsoe-rates.md`).

## 2.3 Calibration

Live-feed regions that do not publish curtailment directly use `curtailment = generation × rate`, with the rate from a 2023/2024 operator or regulator total. Direct-measurement loaders (ONS GNRa, AEMO unconstrained−cleared, Japan area CSVs, netztransparenz `GESAMTE_ARBEIT_MWH` where `RICHTUNG=reduzieren`) do not use a rate for magnitude.

Rates are piecewise-constant per region-year. A single-year rate held backward in time is a documented limitation (§4).

## 2.4 Historical backfill

`data/historical/curtailment_backfill.parquet` is a seven-year hourly reconstruction (2020-01-01 → 2026-04-24) for the 29 regions whose archives support it: 2,590,195 rows. ENTSO-E and EIA families only, at v0.5. AEMO, Elexon, ONS, and the rest have rolling live history, not a seven-year rebuild. The backfill uses the current live rate projected backward; it is not an independent historical calibration. Drift vs published annuals is in §4.

## 2.5 Confidence tiers

Assigned by `src/lib/uncertainty.ts::deriveTier` from `Region.tier`. Documented-gap jurisdictions are not assigned a tier.

| Tier | Criterion | Envelope |
|---|---|---|
| T1a-live-tso | Live feed + own-jurisdiction rate | ±15% of peakGW, or 2σ of backfill peakGW |
| T1b-live-domestic-anchored | Live feed + domestic or split rate | ±50% (empirical; measured on four zones, applied to 26) |
| T1c-live-neighbour-anchored | Live feed + neighbour rate | ±35.5% (Switzerland vs Czech) |
| T2-annual-calibrated | Published annual, or live shape with external rate | ±20% |
| T3-modelled | Annual + typical shape | ±40% |

Current population: **160 T1a, 26 T1b, 1 T1c, 23 T2, 249 T3** (total 459). `npm run tally:tiers` is the audit trail.

T1b today: Germany’s eight TSO-fuel regions, Italy’s fourteen bidding-zone fuel regions, Netherlands wind/solar, Peru solar, Colombia. T1c: Switzerland. T2: seven flat annuals (Austria, Murmansk, four Chinese hydro, Maharashtra) plus sixteen EIA-930 BAs.

## 2.6 Regime changes

Where accounting changed inside the backfill window (Germany EEG Einspeisemanagement → Redispatch 2.0, October 2021), both periods are reconstructed at the current rate. Divergence is a discrepancy in `docs/methodology/validation-discrepancies.md`, not a silent split rate.

## 2.7 Coverage limits

No hourly series is published for jurisdictions with no public hourly source. Mexico CENACE is a documented gap, not a T3 fill. Much of sub-Saharan Africa outside Eskom, and Chinese provincial hours, have no public API; China appears as T3 scaled to NEA utilisation × Ember generation. Full ledger: `docs/known-limitations.md`.

## 2.8 Agentic workflow

Codex and Claude agents ran per-region validation lookups, loader scaffolding, figure code, and first-draft prose. Methodological decisions (tiers, rate rules, discrepancy policy) and the final edit are Simon Collins. Authorship is solo. Prompts and plans are in `docs/superpowers/` and `scripts/validation/enrich_*.py`.

## 2.9 Reproducibility

A tagged commit, free-tier ENTSO-E / EIA / Elexon keys, and `matplotlib`+`pyarrow` rebuild the Parquet files and figures. `npm run reproduce:ercot-west` regenerates the 2024 ERCOT-West backfill partition from the EIA API to 0.1% on row count and aggregate GW.
